summary: When famine struck, Joseph's ten brothers came to Egypt to buy grain and bowed before him, not knowing who he was. Joseph tested them to see if their hearts had changed.

story_reel.narration: Just as God said, the seven good years ended and a terrible famine began. There was no food anywhere, except in Egypt, where Joseph had stored grain. Back in Canaan, Jacob told his sons, 'I hear there is grain in Egypt. Go buy some, so we don't starve.' So ten of Joseph's brothers traveled to Egypt. But Jacob kept Benjamin, the youngest, at home. Benjamin was Joseph's only full brother, and Jacob was afraid of losing him too. In Egypt, the brothers came before the governor and bowed down with their faces to the ground. They didn't recognize him, but Joseph recognized them! He remembered his dreams. They had come true! Joseph decided to test his brothers to see if their hearts had changed. He spoke harshly and said, 'You are spies!' He kept Simeon in prison and told them to bring their youngest brother back. The brothers whispered to each other, 'This is happening because of what we did to Joseph.' Joseph understood every word. He turned away and cried. God's plans had been working all along.

scenes.caption: Famine everywhere
scenes.art_direction: Dry, cracked fields and empty baskets in Canaan.

scenes.caption: Ten brothers travel
scenes.art_direction: The brothers on donkeys crossing the desert toward Egypt; Benjamin waving from home.

scenes.caption: They bow down
scenes.art_direction: Ten brothers bowing before Joseph on a high seat; a faint echo of the bowing-sheaves dream.

scenes.caption: Joseph recognizes them
scenes.art_direction: Close-up of Joseph's eyes widening with memory.

scenes.caption: 'You are spies!'
scenes.art_direction: Joseph speaking sternly through an interpreter; brothers looking frightened.

scenes.caption: Joseph cries
scenes.art_direction: Joseph turning away behind a pillar, wiping tears.

memory_verse.text: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh's plans for me stand firm, even when I can't see them working.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Joseph's dreams came true more than twenty years later! What is something you hope God will do in your life someday?
reflection_choices: Use my gifts to help people

quiz.question: Why did Joseph's brothers go to Egypt?
options: To buy grain during the famine
quiz.explanation: Jacob sent them to Egypt to buy grain so they would live and not die.

quiz.question: Which brother stayed home with Jacob?
quiz.explanation: Jacob didn't send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, because he was afraid harm might come to him.

quiz.question: Which brother did Joseph keep in Egypt?
quiz.explanation: Joseph took Simeon and bound him before their eyes.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, Your plans always stand. Even when I can't see what You're doing, help me trust that You're working everything out. Amen.

companion.message: When my brothers bowed in front of me, I remembered my dreams from so long ago. I wanted to see if their hearts had changed. Mine was about to change too.
